description: This Java class defines the 'ConnectionCreated' event, which is emitted after a 'Connection' object is created within the system. It includes methods for creating instances from objects or JSON, accessing the associated connection, and handling JSON serialization/deserialization. The class is part of an event-driven architecture for connectivity management in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ConnectionCreated
classes.description: Defines an immutable event class representing the creation of a connection, with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and association with connection data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ConnectionCreated event with specified connection, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ConnectionCreated event from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the connection associated with the event.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Provides the JSON representation of the connection entity.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path; here, always empty.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new event with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Adds the connection JSON payload to a JSON object builder.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality, considering the connection.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the event.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the event.
